transcript:
Agent: Yeah, what's the problem?
Customer: Hi, I'm Anjali Gupta. I've been looking at my latest bill and there is a charge for a premium movie package that I never signed up for. It's really frustrating.
Agent: I can help you with that. Before we look at the account, can you give me your account number?
Customer: Yes, it is 53996545.
Agent: Thank you. I see the charge here. I understand how annoying it is to see unexpected charges on your statement.
Customer: Exactly. I just want this removed and my money back.
Agent: I can certainly look into this for you. I will raise a refund request for the wrong charge now.
Customer: Will that be processed immediately?
Agent: The refund is subject to approval and typically takes 7-10 business days to appear in your account.
Customer: Okay, that's fine. I just want to make sure it's fixed.
Agent: Since this is part of a larger billing discrepancy, I'm going to escalate this to our billing specialists for a full review of your account history.
Customer: Alright, they will contact me at 93535 56093?
Agent: Yes, they will. Is there anything else I can help you with today? I've raised the request and the specialists will reach out. Goodbye.
